blocks.title: Better is the Poor Who Walks in Integrity

texts.NIV84: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.
texts.KJV: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
texts.NKJV:
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity
Than one who is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
texts.DRB: Better is the poor man, that walketh in his simplicity, than a rich man that is perverse in his lips, and unwise.

texts.NIV84: It is not good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty and miss the way.
texts.KJV: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
texts.NKJV:
Also it is not good for a soul to be without knowledge,
And he sins who hastens with his feet.
texts.DRB: Where there is no knowledge of the soul, there is no good: and he that is hasty with his feet shall stumble.

texts.NIV84: A man's own folly ruins his life, yet his heart rages against the LORD.
texts.KJV: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
The foolishness of a man twists his way,
And his heart frets against the Lord.
texts.DRB: The folly of a man supplanteth his seeps: and he fretteth in his mind against God.

texts.NIV84: Wealth brings many friends, but a poor man's friend deserts him.
texts.KJV: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
texts.NKJV:
Wealth makes many friends,
But the poor is separated from his friend.
texts.DRB: Riches make many friends: but from the poor man, even they whom he had, depart.

texts.NIV84: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will not go free.
texts.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
texts.NKJV:
A false witness will not go unpunished,
And he who speaks lies will not escape.
texts.DRB: A false witness shall not be unpunished: and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

blocks.title: Descretion Makes a Man Slow to Anger

texts.NIV84: Many curry favor with a ruler, and everyone is the friend of a man who gives gifts.
texts.KJV: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
texts.NKJV:
Many entreat the favor of the nobility,
And every man is a friend to one who gives gifts.
texts.DRB: Many honour the person of him that is mighty, and are friends of him that giveth gifts.

texts.NIV84: A poor man is shunned by all his relatives- how much more do his friends avoid him! Though he pursues them with pleading, they are nowhere to be found.
texts.KJV: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
texts.DRB: The brethren of the poor man hate him: moreover also his friends have departed far from him. He that followeth after words only, shall have nothing.

texts.NIV84: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who cherishes understanding prospers.
texts.KJV: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
texts.NKJV:
He who gets wisdom loves his own soul;
He who keeps understanding will find good.
texts.DRB: But he that possesseth a mind, loveth his own soul, and he that keepeth prudence shall find good things.

texts.NIV84: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who pours out lies will perish.
texts.KJV: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
texts.NKJV:
A false witness will not go unpunished,
And he who speaks lies shall perish.
texts.DRB: A false witness shall not be unpunished: and he that speaketh lies, shall perish.

texts.NIV84: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury- how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
texts.KJV: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
texts.NKJV:
Luxury is not fitting for a fool,
Much less for a servant to rule over princes.
texts.DRB: Delicacies are not seemly for a fool: nor for a servant to have rule over princes.

texts.NIV84: A man's wisdom gives him patience; it is to his glory to overlook an offense.
texts.KJV: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
texts.NKJV:
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger,
And his glory is to overlook a transgression.
texts.DRB: The learning of a man is known by patience and his glory is to pass over wrongs.

texts.NIV84: A king's rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
texts.KJV: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
texts.NKJV:
The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion,
But his favor is like dew on the grass.
texts.DRB: As the roaring of a lion, so also is the anger of a king: and his cheerfulness as the dew upon the grass.

texts.NIV84: A foolish son is his father's ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
texts.KJV: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
texts.NKJV:
A foolish son is the ruin of his father,
And the contentions of a wife are a continual dripping.
texts.DRB: A foolish son is the grief of his father: and a wrangling wife is like a roof continually dropping through.

texts.NIV84: Houses and wealth are inherited from parents, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
texts.KJV: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
Houses and riches are an inheritance from fathers,
But a prudent wife is from the Lord.
texts.DRB: House and riches are given by parents: but a prudent wife is properly from the Lord.

texts.NIV84: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless man goes hungry.
texts.KJV: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
texts.NKJV:
Laziness casts one into a deep sleep,
And an idle person will suffer hunger.
texts.DRB: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep, and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

texts.NIV84: He who obeys instructions guards his life, but he who is contemptuous of his ways will die.
texts.KJV: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
texts.NKJV:
He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul,
But he who is careless of his ways will die.
texts.DRB: He that keepeth the commandment, keepeth his own soul: but he that neglecteth his own way, shall die.

texts.NIV84: He who is kind to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will reward him for what he has done.
texts.KJV: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
texts.NKJV:
He who has pity on the poor lends to the Lord,
And He will pay back what he has given.
texts.DRB: He that hath mercy on the poor, lendeth to the Lord: and he will repay him.

texts.NIV84: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to his death.
texts.KJV: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
texts.NKJV:
Chasten your son while there is hope,
And do not set your heart on his destruction.
texts.DRB: Chastise thy son, despair not: but to the killing of him set not thy soul.

texts.NIV84: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.
texts.KJV: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
texts.NKJV:
A man of great wrath will suffer punishment;
For if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.
texts.DRB: He that is impatient, shall suffer damage: and when he shall take away he shall add another thing.

blocks.title: Many Plans in a Man's Heart

texts.NIV84: Listen to advice and accept instruction, and in the end you will be wise.
texts.KJV: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
texts.NKJV:
Listen to counsel and receive instruction,
That you may be wise in your latter days.
texts.DRB: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayst be wise in thy latter end.

texts.NIV84: Many are the plans in a man's heart, but it is the LORD's purpose that prevails.
texts.KJV: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.
texts.NKJV:
There are many plans in a man’s heart,
Nevertheless the Lord’s counsel—that will stand.
texts.DRB: There are many thoughts in the heart of a man: but the will of the Lord shall stand firm.

texts.NIV84: What a man desires is unfailing love; better to be poor than a liar.
texts.KJV: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
texts.NKJV:
What is desired in a man is kindness,
And a poor man is better than a liar.
texts.DRB: A needy man is merciful: and better is the poor than the lying man.

texts.NIV84: The fear of the LORD leads to life: Then one rests content, untouched by trouble.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord is unto life: and he shall abide in fulness without being visited with evil.

texts.NIV84: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!
texts.KJV: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
texts.NKJV:
A lazy man buries his hand in the bowl,
And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
texts.DRB: The slothful hideth his hand under his armpit, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth.

texts.NIV84: Flog a mocker, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke a discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.
texts.KJV: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
Strike a scoffer, and the simple will become wary;
Rebuke one who has understanding, and he will discern knowledge.
texts.DRB: The wicked man being; scourged, the fool shall be wiser: but if thou rebuke a wise man he will understand discipline.

texts.NIV84: He who robs his father and drives out his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
texts.KJV: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
texts.NKJV:
He who mistreats his father and chases away his mother
Is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
texts.DRB: He that afflicteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is infamous and unhappy.

texts.NIV84: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.
texts.KJV: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
Cease listening to instruction, my son,
And you will stray from the words of knowledge.
texts.DRB: Cease not, O my son, to hear instruction, and be not ignorant of the words of knowledge.

texts.NIV84: A corrupt witness mocks at justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.
texts.KJV: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
texts.NKJV:
A disreputable witness scorns justice,
And the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
texts.DRB: An unjust witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

texts.NIV84: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
texts.KJV: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
texts.NKJV:
Judgments are prepared for scoffers,
And beatings for the backs of fools.
texts.DRB: Judgments are prepared for scorners: and striking hammers for the bodies of fools.
